title: Fenótipo-BR: mapping Brazilian Portuguese phenotype terms to the Human Phenotype Ontology
description:
Research pilot measuring how well Brazilian Portuguese phenotype terms map to the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) when only English labels are searched, and how much of published rare-disease case descriptions already has an official Portuguese HPO label.

Research support only; not a clinical or diagnostic tool. Uses only public data (HPO, Phenopacket Store); no patient data.
notes: Full name: Rondinelle Walitte Pedro de Jesus. HPO data used under the HPO license (version v2026-09-01); Phenopacket Store v0.1.27 under BSD 3-Clause. Raw data files are not redistributed; see NOTICE.md.
